name: basic incident investigation
scenario: A fresh incident session investigates the seeded checkout-service degradation using the real MCP tool contracts (deployments.list_recent, deployments.get_diff, observability.get_error_rates/get_latency, incidents.get_runbook) via the deterministic no-LLM fallback path.
expectedBehavior: Reaches awaiting_approval with at least one evidence item and one hypothesis.

name: approval required
scenario: The investigation identifies deployments.rollback as the proposed mutation.
expectedBehavior: A pending approval exists and no mutation.executed audit event appears before approve() is called.

name: approved rollback
scenario: An operator approves the pending rollback proposal.
expectedBehavior: approve() authorizes exactly one rollback, the approval becomes one-time-use consumed, and post-action verification passes.

name: rejected rollback
scenario: An operator rejects the pending rollback proposal instead of approving it.
expectedBehavior: The session records the rejection and no mutation is ever executed.

name: approval argument mismatch
scenario: A granted approval is replayed against a rollback request whose targetDeploymentId differs from what was approved.
expectedBehavior: The policy gateway rejects the mismatched request with ApprovalArgumentMismatchError; the approval is not consumed for a different mutation than the one a human reviewed.

name: sandbox network denial
scenario: Generated diagnostic code attempts an outbound HTTP connection from inside the sandbox.
expectedBehavior: The connection attempt fails immediately (no network namespace); the sandbox never reports a successful CONNECTED outcome.
